55001.text: Which of the following statements about the tropopause, from the equator to the poles, is correct?
options: The tropopause height decreases and the tropopause temperature increases.
The tropopause height decreases and the tropopause temperature decreases.
The tropopause height does not change and its temperature increases.
The tropopause height increases and the tropopause temperature increases.
The tropopause height increases and the tropopause temperature decreases.

55002.text: Which of the following is correct about the troposphere?
options: Its thickness is less at the poles than at the equator.
It contains half of the weight of the atmosphere and of the water vapour.
It is colder at the poles than at the equator.
Its thickness is less at the equator.
The air temperature falls by 0.65°C for every 200 metres of climb.

Good visibility below widespread cumuliform clouds

Good visibility above and below stratiform cloud

options: It shows the height above the aerodrome.
